metrics.label: Revenue growth
metrics.reading: Revenue compounded 22% a year over 5 years, 18% over 3 (slowing); last 12 months 26%.

metrics.label: Profit growth
metrics.reading: Profit compounded 51% a year over 5 years, 23% over 3; last 12 months 38%.

metrics.label: Cash conversion
metrics.reading: Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 18% of net profit (weak).

metrics.label: Debt
metrics.reading: Borrowings ₹136,936 cr, 1.47× equity; up from ₹77,605 cr in FY22.

bull.point: Management exceeded financial targets, delivering a 20% ROE against an 18% goal and 25% auto revenue growth versus 15-19% guidance.
The company is outperforming on operational promises, including a 5X increase in hospitality room inventory and 34% EPS growth exceeding the 15-20% target.
Operating margins have shown consistent improvement, expanding from 16% in FY22 to 19% by FY26.

bear.point: Production ramp-up and supply chain targets were missed in FY26, with several capacity expansion promises going quiet or being significantly lowered.
Debt levels have risen sharply to 136,936 crores, representing 1.47x equity, while cash conversion remains weak at 18% of net profit.
Multiple growth and industry targets, including revenue growth and tractor industry performance, have lapsed without updates after their respective periods ended.
